name: 3DMigoto
summary: The original DX11 hooking framework that Geo-11 is built upon. Hooks into DirectX 11's rendering pipeline to allow shader replacement, constant injection, and stereo rendering. Still used directly for older 3D Vision-era fixes that have not been ported to Geo-11.
compatibility_notes: Requires DirectX 11. Primarily used with Nvidia 3D Vision driver pipeline for legacy fixes. Geo-11 is the modern replacement for new fix development.
